root_cause.text: The driver allocates a heap-allocated buffer for the device name via kzalloc() and assigns it to dev->init_name, but after device_register() copies the name and sets dev->init_name to NULL, the original heap allocation becomes unreachable and is never freed, causing a memory leak.

After device_register() succeeds, the device core copies the name and sets dev->init_name to NULL, making the original allocation unreachable. There is no kfree(name) on the successful path, so the allocation is never freed. The error path does free name, but the leak occurs on the normal path. This matches the root cause: a memory leak due to not freeing the allocation after device_register() takes ownership.
